title: White House files another SCOTUS emergency appeal over USPS mail ballot rules
script: A new headline is now getting attention across the news cycle. The key update now being reported is: White House files another SCOTUS emergency appeal over USPS mail ballot rules. In simple words, The judge handling the legal battle over new U.S. Postal Service mail ballot rules last week extended her block of the rules for the November midterms Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update.
